blocks.html: Lock down your mesh so only your team can see your position, chat, and data packages. Encrypted devices cannot talk to non-encrypted ones, and vice versa.

slides.title: Open mesh encryption settings
slides.html: Go to Settings > Network Preferences > Network Connection Preferences > Configure AES-256 Mesh Encryption.

slides.title: Generate a key
slides.html: Tap Generate Key to create a new AES-256 encryption key for the team.

slides.title: Name and save the key
slides.html: Enter a file name (no extension) and select OK. The key is saved in the atak/config/prefs folder.

slides.title: Load and share the key
slides.html: On each device, tap Load Key and browse to the key file. Share the same key with everyone before enabling encryption, or preload it onto the devices.

slides.title: Revert to unencrypted
slides.html: To drop encryption and go back to plain mesh traffic, tap Forget Key.
